### DEV-000 Short title

- **Rule / requirement deviated from:** (e.g. MISRA C:2012 Rule 11.5, CERT EXP36-C, HW standard 2)
- **Location:** file:line / net / feature
- **Justification:** why compliance is impossible or disproportionate
- **Risk assessment:** what could go wrong; compensating measures; test evidence
- **Scope & duration:** permanent | until <event>
- **Approved by / date:**
